title: Discovery
description: We gather requirements, understand your business goals, analyze your audience, and define project scope and success metrics.

title: Strategy
description: We plan site structure, content architecture, user journeys, and technical approach aligned with your conversion goals.

title: Design
description: We create wireframes and high-fidelity UI designs, iterating based on your feedback until every detail is perfect.

title: Development
description: We build your website with clean, performant code using modern frameworks, following best practices throughout.

title: Testing
description: We conduct thorough QA across devices and browsers, optimize performance, and ensure accessibility compliance.

title: Launch
description: We deploy your website to production, configure DNS, SSL, analytics, and ensure everything runs flawlessly.

title: Support
description: We provide ongoing maintenance, updates, and optimization to keep your website performing at its best.
